chunks: How many gardens and fountains did they leave behind,
ai.seo_question: What did the people of Thamud leave behind after their destruction?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the tangible legacy of the Thamud, whose abandonment of fertile lands and water sources serves as a physical testament to their sudden demise. It highlights the concept of 'tark' (leaving behind) not merely as loss, but as a preserved sign for future generations to reflect upon the consequences of rejecting divine guidance.
